name: _dialog.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences/_dialog.scss — the preferences dialog shell — :host open/closed display, backdrop, genie-zoom panel (--genie-x/y origin), header + title, reduced-motion.
//  Imported by preferences.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Preferences Modal Dialog
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

:host {
  display: none;
}

:host([open]),
:host(.is-open) {
  display: block;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
}

// Backdrop: fullscreen dim/blur layer behind the dialog; the genie zoom uses --genie-x/y as transform origin.
.pref-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  z-index: 10000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  // Simple uniform padding — box-sizing:border-box ensures width:100% accounts
  // for this padding so the dialog always fits within the viewport and
  // flexbox centering works symmetrically on all viewport sizes.
  padding: to-rem($space-xl);
  // Light veil: the menu animation behind must stay readable
  background: rgba($color-black, 0.28);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  outline: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.55s ease;

  // Genie: the dialog zooms from / to the control that opened it.
  // transform-origin is set inline (--genie-x/--genie-y, relative to the dialog box).
  &--enter,
  &--leave {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  &--enter .pref-dialog,
  &--leave .pref-dialog {
    transform: scale(0.04) translateY(to-rem($space-xl));
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  }

  &--leave,
  &--leave .pref-dialog {
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

// The dialog card itself — scales from its trigger point via the genie custom properties.
.pref-dialog {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  // The backdrop padding constrains the width to grid; 610px cap prevents
  // the dialog from stretching too wide on large viewports.
  max-width: to-rem($space-8xl);
  max-height: calc(88vh);
  max-height: calc(88dvh);
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: to-rem($space-xl);
  box-shadow: 0 to-rem(24) to-rem(48) to-rem(-12) rgba($color-black, 0.35);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transform-origin: var(--genie-x, 50%) var(--genie-y, 50%);
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  transition:
    transform 0.72s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
    opacity 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
    filter 0.6s ease;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .pref-backdrop,
  .pref-dialog {
    transition: none;
  }
}

// Dialog top row: title + circular close button.
.pref-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
  border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
}

// Dialog heading.
.pref-title {
  @extend .ttl-sm;

  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(-0.2);
  color: inherit;
}
